Delhi High Court Rules Aadhaar Not Sole Proof of Date of Birth

The Delhi High Court has ruled that an Aadhaar card alone cannot be considered definitive proof of a person's date of birth. This decision upholds a previous ruling concerning a worker, though specific details of the worker's case were not provided in the coverage. The court's pronouncement clarifies that while Aadhaar is a valid identification document, it is insufficient on its own to establish a date of birth.
